actions.name: create_list
actions.title: Create list
actions.help: Creates a list in Collection. Collection works like a database. It can store lists, which correspond to database tables.Collection lists are not durable i.e. they are available only within the job they are created in.

input.name: list_source
input.label: List source
input.hint: Creates a table like structure in a collection. Select list pill as source. Collections support a maximum of 50,000 list entries or 10 MB size limit.

input.name: list_name
input.label: List name
input.hint: Provide a name for the list. E.g: contacts, orders. You can use this name in your SQL query.

actions.name: create_list_from_csv
actions.title: Create list from CSV file
actions.help: Creates a list in Collection from CSV content. Collection works like a database. It can store lists, which correspond to database tables.Collection lists are not durable i.e. they are available only within the job they are created in.

input.name: list_source
input.label: CSV source
input.hint: Creates a table like structure in a collection. Select list CSV string as source. Collections support a maximum of 50,000 list entries or 10 MB size limit.

input.name: list_name
input.label: List name
input.hint: Provide a name for the list. E.g: contacts, orders. You can use this name in your SQL query.

input.name: file_encoded_type
input.label: File encoded type
input.hint: Default encoding type is set to UTF-8 .

input.name: csv_schema_json
input.label: Columns names
input.hint: Describe the CSV columns

input.name: headers
input.label: Ignore CSV header row
input.hint: Set the value to true if the CSV source has a header row in it.

input.name: col_sep
input.label: Column delimiter
input.hint: This is the character used to separate column values in each line of the CSV

actions.name: insert_rows
actions.title: Insert rows
actions.description: Insert rows into list in Collection
actions.help: Insert rows into a list in Collection. Collection works like a database. It can store lists, which correspond to database tables.Collection lists are not durable i.e. they are available only within the job they are created in.

input.name: list_source
input.label: List source
input.hint: Inserted as rows into a table like structure in a collection. Select list pill as source. Collections support a maximum of 50,000 list entries or 10 MB size limit.

input.name: list_name
input.label: List name
input.hint: Provide a name for the list. E.g: contacts, orders. You can use this name in your SQL query.

input.name: create_table_if_not_exist
input.label: Create table if table doesn't exist?
input.hint: Creates a table if table does not yet exist. Default is true.

actions.name: query_list
actions.title: Query lists
actions.help: Lists within Collection can be queried using SQL. Use the datapill from the Create list step as the table name. Standard SQL keywords and syntax applies. Query returns a maximum of 50,000 entries.

input.name: sql
input.label: SQL query
input.hint: Treat lists as tables when forming your SQL. Joins are supported

input.name: result_schema_json
input.label: Output list schema
input.hint: Describe the fields returned by above SQL query

input.name: output_schema_by
input.label: Keep track of output fields by
input.hint: Configure this if your output list schema does not have fixed output field order or names: - If Output field order is set: Your output list schema must have fixed field order. Output field names doesn…

input.name: csv
input.label: Write result to CSV
input.hint: The query result will be converted to a CSV string. The CSV column order follows the schema specified above

input.name: col_sep
input.label: Column delimiter
input.hint: This is the character used to separate column values in each line of the CSV
